### Observed differences

- A06 appeared in about 14 in 100 traces before and about 82 in 100 after; its mean occurrences per trace rose from 0.135 to 0.855. [OCC002]
- A02 and A08 became less frequent: A02 from about 24% to 12% of traces, A08 from about 25% to 7%. [OCC001, OCC003]
- A06 now co-occurs with A19, A20, A25, A26, A27, A30, A35, A36, A41, A42, A43, A46, A51 and A52 in about 82% of traces, up from about 13.5%; in most of these A06 occurs before the other activity, except A46, which occurs before A06. [REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL007, REL008, REL009, REL010, REL011, REL012, REL013, REL014]
- A46's outgoing transitions shifted from mostly to A19 (39%) and A20 (43%) to mostly to A06 (79%). [DIR014]
- A06's outgoing transitions shifted from A15, A50, A16 and others to A19 (49%) and A20 (41%). [DIR003]
- A25's main successor changed from A27 (97.5%) to A43, A41, A36, A42 and A35 (each about 16–23%). [DIR007]
- A26's main successor changed from A36, A42, A35, A41 and A43 to A30 (95.5%). [DIR008]
- A30, which before was a successor of A35, A36, A41, A42 and A43 (17–24% each), almost disappeared as their successor; A27 appeared as a successor of these activities. [DIR009, DIR010, DIR011, DIR012, DIR013]
- The order between A26/A27 and A35/A36/A41/A42/A43 reversed: before, A26/A27 preceded those activities in about 97–99% of co-occurring traces; after, those activities precede A26/A27 in about 97–98%. [REL015, REL016, REL017, REL018, REL019, REL020, REL021, REL022, REL023, REL024]
- Positions shifted accordingly: A06 moved earlier (mean position 0.49 to 0.34), A26/A27 moved later (0.52 to 0.66 and 0.39 to 0.53), and A35/A36/A41/A42/A43 moved earlier (about 0.60 to 0.45). [POS001, POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005, POS006, POS007, POS008]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that A06 was introduced as a step between A46 and A19/A20: in the later window, A46 leads to A06, A06 leads to A19/A20, and A06 is present in most traces, whereas before A46 led directly to A19/A20 and A06 was rare. This is directly shown by the successor changes and the co-occurrence/order relations. A competing explanation that cannot be fully ruled out is that A06 existed before but was too rare to be captured reliably; however, the magnitude and consistency of the change make this unlikely.

Other differences: the relative order of A26/A27 and A35/A36/A41/A42/A43 reversed, with A25 no longer leading to A27 and A26 now leading to A30; A30 no longer follows the group of A35/A36/A41/A42/A43. A02 and A08 also became less frequent. These appear to be separate structural changes rather than consequences of the A06 insertion.
